Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog:
v0.1.2.33 - 2026-11-21: Fixed "Turn on when a match starts" never engaging (it only ran during the loading screen, when no player exists, so the rotation loaded but never acted in matches; it now latches during the load and engages on the first cycle with a loaded player) and slash commands registering only near the end of a 10-30 second start-up (now registered first, with a start-up log line listing them). Release harness now fails the build when a documented command has no registration call site in the built assembly or the match-start auto-on core cannot engage. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.32 - 2026-11-21: Fixed rotations never loading (silent no-op in PvP since 0.1.2.26): the duty-rotation removal had also removed the call that fills the rotation list from the assembly scan. The call and the rotation-group count log line are restored, an empty scan now logs an error, and a release-harness gate fails when the rotation-load wiring is severed or the scan finds no rotations. No PvE content returns. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.31 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 6 completion. Four unreferenced PvE statuses whose generated doc text still carried a marker word (ThrownForALoop, Soteria, BackFromTheBrink, BannerOfHonedAcuity) leave the StatusID table. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.30 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 6. PvE-only target finders (AST cards, Phantom Respite), the provoke/shirk machinery, PvE event-status gates (Scalebound, Shackled, Transcendent), the tank-buster target list, positional leftovers and 17 unreferenced PvE statuses are removed. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.29 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 5 completion. Six PvE boss-specific tank-buster effect paths and seven unreferenced chocobo-race statuses are removed. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.28 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 5. The Auto True North setting and positional map, the tank-stance and provoke-for-tank settings, the Blue Mage code and setting, chocobo companion handling, job traits, the unused job-filter types and the Raise statuses are removed. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.27 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 4. The generated PvE catalog (PvE action ids, per-job PvE action properties, PvE-content statuses, the content-type enum), the Raise and duty-action leftovers, the PvE filter attribute, 89 unused UI strings and several PvE-only engine tables are removed. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.26 - 2026-11-20: Follow-up cleanup to 0.1.2.25 from the PvE audit. A tooltip, two duty-specific VFX paths, two unused strings and legacy commented code are removed. No PvP behaviour change.
v0.1.2.25 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 3. Raise settings, logic and the Raise/Shirk command, the AutoDuty and Henchman modes, the action-interception system, and the remaining duty, alliance-raid, Fate, hunt, NPC-healing, Cactbot and supporter settings are removed. No PvP rotation change.
v0.1.2.23 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal, round 2. The duty-rotation engine is removed: the whole Basic/Rotations/Duties subsystem (DutyRotation and the Bozja, Emanation, Monster Hunter, Orbonne, Phantom and Variant duty shells, DutyTerritoryAttribute), the DutyRotations command and its command handling, the duty-rotation hooks, settings rows and command plumbing in the rotation updaters, config classes and the rotation config window (including the duty tab), the Masked Carnivale helper, and the duty-rotation template in the source generators (a 620 KB PvE duty catalog that no longer ships). The BossModReborn boss-timeline integration is removed: the BMRTimeline IPC subscriber, the BossMod updater and its download path, the timeline raidwide/tankbuster/knockback mitigation windows, the timeline debug panel and its config toggles; the plugin no longer talks to Boss Mod Reborn. The last PvE-only catalog entries are scrubbed from the source generators: the Mega, Soothing, Resistance, Resistance Kit and Occult potion actions, the Dungeons, Deep Dungeons and V&C Dungeon Finder content types, and the To-the-Dungeons status. A regression from the removal edit is fixed before release: the DoActions, ToggleActions, Settings and NextAction command cases were briefly lost with the duty command and are restored verbatim from 0.1.2.22. No PvP rotation behavior change. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.22 - 2026-11-20: PvE remnant removal. The entire potion/item auto-use subsystem is removed: HP potion, MP potion, medicine and Phoenix Down item actions, the item action base classes (IBaseItem, BaseItem, ItemConfig), the tincture-use setting, and every auto-use setting, config key, cooldown-window filter and debug panel that referenced them. This backs out the 0.1.2.21 potion port (upstream 996f281830) and its whole subsystem; items cannot be used in PvP. No PvP rotation behavior change. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.20 - 2026-11-18: Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn c170c9cd5d, source reorganization). Upstream moved its engine code into new folders and namespaces with no behavior change; this plugin keeps its own layout and carries the behavior-bearing parts: all 21 PvP rotations declare game version 7.58 with updated source links, a saved rotation choice also resolves by short name, and the settings generators handle one type split across several files. No rotation behavior change. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.19 - 2026-11-17: Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn 866988a7ee, status and target check improvements). Status reads behind target selection use the game status array directly, effect-time uses a monotonic clock, decimal settings and timed action commands parse with the invariant culture first, delayed target switching skips despawned candidates, and an unreadable config is backed up before reset. Testing channel only.
v0.1.2.18 - 2026-11-15: UI polish: the first-start tutorial, control and cooldown windows, legacy settings header and popups use the plugin window style (v0.1.2.14 to v0.1.2.17 carried the Dalamud 7.58 rebuild and the LalaUiKit settings window).
v0.1.2.13 - 2026-11-09: Removed the AI decision layer. The optional relayed decision model, its settings row and its relay address field are gone; the plugin makes no decision calls and no longer sends fight snapshots anywhere. Targeting, Guard, the defensive table, StickyTarget and every other rotation behavior are unchanged; the defensive rules keep reading real HP (now under the neutral name RealHp.HpRatio), and no threshold moved.
v0.1.2.11 - 2026-11-05: Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn a560469db). The engine now builds in upstream's merged single-project layout. Ports upstream engine fixes: the action manager is read at call time instead of a pointer cached at startup, config saves are atomic, and the shield-value math can no longer overflow on very large HP values. No rotation behavior change.
v0.1.2.4 - 2026-10-22: Upstream sync (RotationSolverReborn 79f60d87c) - all 21 PvP rotations now carry the 'Reborn' rotation-type tag, upstream's marker for rotations written for the pre-Evercold job kits. Metadata only; no gameplay change.
v0.1.0.13 - 2026-08-25: Adds a "PvPHighestPressure" targeting mode that focuses whichever enemy your own team is already piling onto, and target stickiness so auto-target stops abandoning an enemy while your own timed debuff (Wildfire and similar) is still ticking on it. Both requested in issue #4.
v0.1.0.12 - 2026-08-06: Upstream sync (RotationSolverReborn 35ceb6e82) - all 21 PvP rotations now declare GameVersion 7.55. Metadata-only; no gameplay change. The Doom-guard logic in that commit lives in upstream base classes this fork does not track.
v0.1.0.11 - 2026-08-03: Fixed per-frame 'no rotation found' log spam outside PvP (issue #3) - UpdateCustomRotation returns early when not in PvP and the remaining no-rotation warnings are throttled.
